sections.notes: Put-in Dam Quarry Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Norfork #1 Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Cold tailwater below Norfork Dam. Hydroelectric and flood-control releases change river flow; check current releases and the observed river level before launching. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found). Norfork #1 is on the White River just downstream of the North Fork confluence; identify the correct public ramp during your shuttle.

notices.title: Dam-controlled tailwater
notices.text: This reach is below Norfork Dam. Cold water and changing releases affect the float; check current dam operations and river conditions. A dotted course shows river bends, not safe depth, a rapid line or an exact landing connection.
notices.sourceName: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission — tailwater information

sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview. Historical source centerlines generalize shore margins and gravel bars; water level and changing channels can alter the usable course. The line does not map safe navigation, landing connections or GPS remaining time. The overview continues onto the White River toward Norfork #1; it does not stop at the confluence.
